title: Going deeper: Trust grows through evidence
categoryContext: Growing independence at home, school and online
stageSummary: Own impact, keep reasonable limits and create a concrete path back into relationship and learning.
possibleWeather: Older children may hear pressure as mistrust, public judgement or loss of agency. Make the reason, choice and responsibility visible.
boundary: Trust requires changed actions over time.
practice: agree on one observable action that can rebuild trust
principle: Treat trust as a process supported by evidence, not a permanent identity verdict.
nextSentence: Trust requires changed actions over time. Tell me what is getting in the way, then we can agree on one observable action that can rebuild trust.
keyLearning: Treat trust as a process supported by evidence, not a permanent identity verdict.
